provider: Polisa independent public insurance market compilation

request_contract.parameter_rules: Documentation-only publisher README path. README lists polisa-all-markets.csv and per-market exports, but landing page text in this review contradicts CSV availability. Do not construct dataset file requests, scrape insurer pages, enumerate endpoints, follow unreviewed export links or import provider rows. Before any executable contract, resolve current live export identity, exact file URL, source-level permissions, commercial automation rules and original response-size/hash bounds.

response_contract.format: Polisa README text describes a proposed or available CSV version and detailed source caveats, not an authenticated CSV source or parsed insurer record.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: Market-level named insurer and line-of-business premiums/claims/solvency statistics reconstructed from heterogeneous regulators, associations and insurer SFCRs. Account for entity-group rollups, currencies, conversion date, year, coverage and original-source lineage; not property location, actual insured TIV or model-ready CAT loss.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: Documentation-only; no live provider request, bulk download or automated enumeration is authorized by this contract.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: README names 2026-11-09.d5ad62; site displays another as-of date. Neither fixes a verified export file checksum nor consistent API schema; do not assume data availability from filenames.

rights_and_policy.notes: Polisa-generated ratios/shares are stated CC BY 4.0 but rights from original sources remain in force; restrictions include Serbia NBS for commercial use, other national associations and Estonia share-alike. Treat commercial use as unknown pending exact market/row/source check and resolve possible export-availability contradictions before automation.

notes: Documented-only readiness contract; zero supplier CSV bytes collected or uploaded. Exact source-level licences and mixed provenance preclude blanket commercial reuse and automatic insurer exposure calibration.
